operators.definition: Replace the literal environment/content while rebuilding a truthful layered photographic field and subject-derived information zones.
operators.failure_boundary: Generic stock backdrop, flat depth, no local type-safe field or arbitrary source-surface reuse.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One different truthful environment or process image, same information roles, one formal output, local contrast/depth audit and human pixel review.

operators.definition: Recompose—not scale—the depth frame, information registers, title mass and quiet zones for a materially different aspect ratio.
operators.failure_boundary: Proportional scaling, empty extension, duplicated title, lost peripheral balance or unprotected microcopy.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One 16:9 or 9:16 full-image recomposition from the same capsule evidence; no new style rules; thumbnail and normal-view hierarchy review.

operators.definition: Change subject and accent hues while preserving luminance authority, saturation scarcity and role separation between environment, primary type, support and optional accent.
operators.failure_boundary: Literal green/orange recolor recipe, accent overexpansion, reduced text contrast or implausible environmental color.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One role-preserving alternate palette plus an accent-omission control; verify local contrast and material plausibility.

operators.definition: Produce a quieter or denser family member by changing photographic and graphic density regionally and inversely rather than changing all regions together.
operators.failure_boundary: Every zone becomes busy, title shrinks without photo simplification, or quiet version becomes passive empty space.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One lower-density and one higher-density planned composition, each preserving three reads and local information safety.

operators.definition: Replace or omit path, badge and semantic graphic devices using forms derived from the new subject/process/identity rather than source tokens.
operators.failure_boundary: Copied mountain/seal/scribble, arbitrary sticker language or decorative path without semantic work.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One subject-derived motif execution compared with an omission control; human review determines whether the motif earns its presence.

operators.definition: Replace the literal title with newly authored, exact and legible display lettering that preserves combined-mass behavior without copying source contours; rebuild functional copy and hierarchy truthfully.
operators.failure_boundary: Stock-font collapse, copied 山野集 contours, wrong characters, unreadable erosion, fake calligraphy or title detached from the photograph.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One full-image new-copy test using an approved source asset, exact-copy gate, no hidden variants and human pixel review.

operators.definition: Transfer the hierarchy and photo-design relationships into another photographic or print/material treatment without copying the source's eroded title surface as a generic texture.
operators.failure_boundary: Global grunge, faux-rustic texture, loss of material credibility or treating speckle as the family itself.
operators.minimum_future_validation_experiment: One restrained alternate photographic/print treatment with unchanged hierarchy, followed by detail-scale realism and non-copy review.
